description: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup Recipe🧀🍅 Asking people if I could cook them one meal, what would it be?!  Fire Escape Chronicles Pt. 17 🧯 Recipe below 👇🏽  #grilledcheese #grilled #cheese  #cheesepull #bacon #gruyere #cheddar #pepperjack #Tomato #soup #tomatosoup #creamytomatosoup #bisque #souprecipe  #tomatobisquesoup #tomatobisque #recipe #recipies #comfortfood #Comfortmeals #veganrecipes #plantbased #sanMarzano  Tomato Soup:  1. Peeled Tomatoes from San Marzano Can  2. 1 Bell Pepper  3. 1 White onion  4. 1 whole garlic  5. Olive Oil  6. Salt + pepper  7. 1 tbsp sugar  8. 1 tbsp garlic  9. 1/4- 1/2 cup of heavy cream  10. 1-2 tbsp butter  11. 1 tsp Parsley flakes  12. 1 tsp chili  13. Squeeze of lemon  Bacon Jam:  1. 5 slices of bacon cut to small pieces  2. 1 white onion  3. 2 shallots  4. 2 garlic minced  5. 1/2 cup of brown sugar  6. 1/3 cup of maple syrup  7. 1/3 cup of apple cider vinegar  Grilled Cheese  1. Gruyere  2. Cheddar  3. Pepper Jack  4. 3 pieces of bacon  Mayo Sauce  1. 4 tbsp of mayo  2. Fresh herbs 1/2 tbsp  3. 1/2 tbsp garlic powder  ————DIRECTIONS—————  Directions | Tomato Soup:  1. Add Tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, garlic wrapped in tin foil into a tray. Season with olive oil and salt+pepper  2. Put it into a 400 F oven for about 40 minutes or until vegetables have a char to it.  3. Take out the vegetables from the oven and blend by adding in Heavy Cream.  4. Put it onto the stove and add in sugar, butter, parsley flakes, chili, and lemon. You can add more heavy cream here if you need. Directions | Bacon Jam:  1. Cook bacon down and remove and leave bacon fat.  2. Cook onions and shallots for about 15 minutes 3. Add in garlic, brown sugar, maple syrup, bacon, and apple cider vinegar  4. Simmer for about 5 minutes and set aside.  Directions | Grilled Cheese:  1. Lather Mayo sauce on both sides and place on a low flame, hot pan 2. Place bacon jam on both inside sides and top with cheese and bacon.  3. Close and continue to flip till token brown

description: It pained me to cut the 2 hours of carefully putting up wallpaper into 1 second! 😂 backstory ::: While cleaning, Kay asked me to take a stuffed animal (named bun) to the nursery. I dropped off it off and realized just how bad the nursery had gotten. I knew that Kay was overwhelmed by the nursery, and even though that she wanted so badly to get it all set up, she felt defeated by how messy it had become. I knew that she was going to get her nails done in the afternoon, so I put a plan into action to clean up the nursery. I got out the boxes, opened them, and disposed of them! I put up the wallpaper, organized, and cleaned the room! It may not seem like much because of how fast it was shown, but it took hours! 😂 and I was a little sweaty (seen in the beginning). Kay finally came home and I rushed to the door to catch her reaction. She came in and saw how the room had been revived! She loved it so much and I think it revitalized her excitement for finishing the room! I am so glad that I’m able to do these little things for her when I get a smidge of free time! She deserves this and more because she’s been working so hard to grow our baby bean. Hopefully bean will be born soon and we can finally start using all of this baby stuff that we’ve collected! 😂❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant

description: The puppy pad at the end! 🙈😂 backstory ::: Kay LOVES the holidays. She especially loves the different types of foods! She talks about the different casseroles and dishes throughout the year and gets so happy when she finally eats them during the holidays. ❤️ This year was going to be different for us… Since Ellie was due during Thanksgiving, we knew that we wouldn’t be able to go see family, and we would have our hands too full with bean to be able to cook thanksgiving foods for ourselves. Kay was sad, but she had come to terms with the fact that she wouldn’t get to celebrate with family this year. 😔 Well! My family and I cooked up a little plan; While Kay and I were gone to bean’s first doctors appointment, my family ran to the store and got the stuff to cook up all of Kay’s favorite thanksgiving dishes. I’m so glad that she was able to have her favorite holiday foods this year. I’m also so thankful that my family wanted to help make her day! She deserves it after all that she went through to have our precious baby bean! ❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant

description: It’s FINALLY finished! 🎉❤️ Backstory ::: Kay and our nursery had a love-hate relationship. During her pregnancy, she tried to get the nursery put together, but with the limited space. I noticed that the nursery got backed up full of boxes, and so once when she was out, I cleaned it all up and gave her a fresh start to make the nursery! So when we got back, while Kay was taking care of Ellie, I got into the nursery and finished it off! It’s finally done! 😂 Kay decorated it so well! It looks amazing! I’m so happy for her because she put so much time into researching the perfect baby stuff, so I’m glad that it turned out just how she wanted it! Now we can make many many memories with Ellie in this room! (Most of which will be stinky) 😂 #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant #postpartum

description: She already wants a “nugget” 😳 backstory ::: My wife has just given birth to our beautiful daughter. She is so excited to finally have Ellie here, but is sad that her pregnancy is over. Kay gave birth before her due date, and was not expecting it to happen the night it did. We were on a date, having dinner, and she started getting contractions. Soon after, she went into labor. It was very random and so to her, it felt like one moment she was pregnant, and the next she wasnt. She misses the kicks, and the cravings, and the experience of being pregnant. 😔 Kay had such a beautiful pregnancy journey and it was so much fun seeing her slowly grow our daughter! I loved every minute of it, and think that she did an amazing job getting through pregnancy. Since Kay just gave birth, she has been extra emotional, which is likely why she is so sad about not being pregnant. Over time, this sadness will go away and all that will be left are the wonderful memories we made. ❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #pregnant #postpartum

description: How did I not know this was a thing? 😳😅 Backstory ::: We’ve had two great weeks with bean. I’ve learned a lot about taking care of a newborn. Before bean I had never even changed a diaper. 😂 While changing her, I noticed that her umbilical cord had fallen off in her clothing. I didn’t think this was a big deal so I finished changing her and threw it in the trash. This was a mistake. 😂 Apparently Kay had been waiting on it to fall off so that she could save it forever in a little plastic bag. I’m not sure why she wanted it so bad but she’s made it clear that it’s very important that she keeps it. Later while she was changing Ellie, she started yelling my name to come to her. She had noticed that her umbilical cord was missing and panicked. She then retrieved the umbilical cord from the trash and stored it safely in a little plastic bag. I’m so thankful that I put off taking out the trash. I hope that when bean grows up, she’s super excited to have a small dried fragment of her belly button. 😂 #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant #postpartum

description: I will cherish this moment forever! 🥹❤️ backstory ::: Kay and I have spent the last 3 months with our baby, Elliott. We have been through so many moments together, and the whole journey has been amazing. Ellie is the happiest, smiliest baby that I’ve ever seen and we feel so blessed to have her in our life. She has been hitting a lot of milestones lately, like holding things, holding herself up during tummy time, and so much more. One thing she has been trying to do is laugh. She’s been able to squeeze out a little hiccup sounding laugh for a little while, but we’ve never heard a true laugh. Until now! Kay was playing with Ellie and saw that she was super smiley and happy and thought that she might laugh. She called me over and was playing peekaboo. description: Ellie’s laugh at the end! 🥹😂 backstory ::: While at a checkup with Ellie’s doctor, we were told that she was excelling with her head support and hitting all of the milestones that she should be at for her age! It is so funny how Ellie will balance for a second and then accept her fate as she falls over without even trying to catch herself. 😂 It’s so funny for us to see, and Ellie seems to enjoy it too. We are so excited for her to be able to sit up on her own! It’s amazing how far she has come in only (almost) 5 months. I am so excited to see her continue to grow and learn new things! ❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant #postpartum

description: USA’s most scenic road?! DETAILS ⬇️😍 📍 The Zion-Mount Carmel Road in Zion National Park, Utah is a scenic 25-mile stretch connecting Zion National Park, Grand Canyon National Park, and Bryce Canyon National Park, showcasing the stunning red rock canyons and cliffs that make these national parks famous. 🌄 Along this unforgettable drive, you’ll pass through towering sandstone formations, slickrock canyons, and the historic 1.1-mile Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel. At the time of its completion, in 1930, the Zion-Mt. Carmel Tunnel was the longest in the world and is still considered an engineering marvel to this day!  🛣️ No reservation is currently required to drive this road, but vehicles over 11’4” in height or 7’10” in width (including mirrors) will need an escort to pass through the Zion Tunnel, available for a fee during set hours. Check nps.gov for details on tunnel restrictions and traffic conditions. 🌅 This spectacular drive is one of the best ways to see Zion National Park! We’ve driven it multiple times during day trips to Bryce Canyon National Park and have been stunned every single time. We recommend driving it early or later in the day to avoid heavy traffic and catch the red cliffs glowing in the soft morning or evening light. 💌 Send this to someone who needs to take this drive with you! Comment if you have a drive you think is just as beautiful if not more! 🙌🏼 #roadtrip #usaroadtrip #utah #zionnationalpark #pixarcars #carsmovie #lifeisahighway #nationalparks

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

Shri Mangal Dev Temple of Amalner is one of the most ancient, most rare and most ‘live’ temples in entire India.. A temple where people experience fulfillment of wishes and desires.
It is public knowledge that temples of Shri Mangal Dev are very rare. Who constructed the Mangal Dev Grah (planet) temple in Amalner and when was the idol established? There is no authentic information regarding this. Some believe that the temple was renovated for the first time in 1933. After 1940 the temple once again went into oblivion and reached a stage of dilapidation. Till 1999 the surroundings of the temple were used as a dumping ground for the town’s waste. It was also a hideout for criminals and other anti-social activities. This fact seems unbelievable but is unfortunately true.
The post 1999 renovation has brought about a miraculously pleasant transformation in the temple and its surroundings. In the last 5 to 7 years the pace of development of the place and facilities has increased.
Temple area have two halls, Tulsi garden, for water harvesting built six bunds, fountain, spectacular lighting, picturesque places, Canteen, children play in the Rotary Garden, live rabbits, fish, shellfish, devotees accommodation and all kinds of services and facilities due to this temple got famous as the picnic spot and tourist attraction.
So many schools, colleges, organizations, political parties, associations, clubs, society, social, religious, cultural institutions and the various programs come there for the trip They are cooperated by management . However, it is necessary to allow management before any program And the area of the temple is a temple had won the right to give or not to give permission to any management program There are two AC rooms, one attached non-AC room, two big halls, and adequate number of washrooms in the temple premises. Accommodation is provided at affordable cost. There are good lodges in the town also.

Amalner situated on the Bori River bank is a city in Jalgaon district of Maharashtra state is a municipal corporation. Amalner is a Taluka in Jalgaon district.

HOW TO REACH :
By Bus : 
Distance in Km to reach at Temple
  Jalgaon To Mangal Graha Temple,Amalner : 55Km To 60 Km
  Dhule To Amalner: 36Km

Shri Mangal Dev Temple of Amalner is one of the most ancient, most rare and most ‘live’ temples in entire India.. A temple where people experience fulfillment of wishes and desires.
It is public knowledge that temples of Shri Mangal Dev are very rare. Who constructed the Mangal Dev Grah (planet) temple in Amalner and when was the idol established? There is no authentic information regarding this. Some believe that the temple was renovated for the first time in 1933. After 1940 the temple once again went into oblivion and reached a stage of dilapidation. Till 1999 the surroundings of the temple were used as a dumping ground for the town’s waste. It was also a hideout for criminals and other anti-social activities. This fact seems unbelievable but is unfortunately true.
The post 1999 renovation has brought about a miraculously pleasant transformation in the temple and its surroundings. In the last 5 to 7 years the pace of development of the place and facilities has increased.
Temple area have two halls, Tulsi garden, for water harvesting built six bunds, fountain, spectacular lighting, picturesque places, Canteen, children play in the Rotary Garden, live rabbits, fish, shellfish, devotees accommodation and all kinds of services and facilities due to this temple got famous as the picnic spot and tourist attraction.
So many schools, colleges, organizations, political parties, associations, clubs, society, social, religious, cultural institutions and the various programs come there for the trip They are cooperated by management . However, it is necessary to allow management before any program And the area of the temple is a temple had won the right to give or not to give permission to any management program There are two AC rooms, one attached non-AC room, two big halls, and adequate number of washrooms in the temple premises. Accommodation is provided at affordable cost. There are good lodges in the town also.

Amalner situated on the Bori River bank is a city in Jalgaon district of Maharashtra state is a municipal corporation. Amalner is a Taluka in Jalgaon district.

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

What is Pita ? 
let's find out 👇🏼
 Pita OR  Flatbread
Pita or pitta, is a family of yeast-leavened round flatbreads baked from wheat flour, common in the Mediterranean, Middle East, and neighboring areas.It includes the widely known version with an interior pocket, also known as Arabic bread (Arabic: خبز عربي; khubz ʿarabī), In England, Greek bread is used for pocket versions such as the Greek pita, are used for barbecues to a souvlaki wrap.
The Western name pita may sometimes be used to refer to various other types of flatbreads that have different names in their local languages, such as numerous styles of Arab khubz (bread) 

Preparation
Six pitas baking on a circular pan in a wood-fired oven
Pita baking in Nazareth
Most pita are baked at high temperatures (450–475 °F (232–246 °C)), which turns the water in the dough into steam, thus causing the pita to puff up and form a pocket.[24] When removed from the oven, the layers of baked dough remain separated inside the deflated pita, which allows the bread to be opened to form a pocket. However, pita is sometimes baked without pockets and is called "pocket-less pita". Regardless of whether it is made at home or in a commercial bakery, pita is proofed for a very short time—only 15 minutes.

Modern commercial pita bread is prepared on advanced automatic lines. These lines have high production capacities, processing 100,000-pound (45,000 kg) pound silos of flour at a time and producing thousands of loaves per hour. The ovens used in commercial baking are much hotter than traditional clay ovens—800–900 °F (427–482 °C)—so each loaf is baked only for one minute. The pita are then air-cooled for about 20 minutes on conveyor belts before being shipped immediately or else stored in commercial freezers kept at a temperature of 10 °F (−12 °C).

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

HOW TO REACH MANGAL GRAHA MANDIR AMALNER | WHY DO WE SEE MANGAL GRAH MANDIR STICKER ON EVERY VEHICLE HERE | NO PAID DARSHAN IN THIS TEMPLE |  WHY PRASAD IS SOLD AT RS 54 | Manglik Defects Are Removed In The Temple Of Mars | TOURIST PLACES IN JALGAON | AMALNER | KHANDESH 

Shri Mangal Dev Temple of Amalner is one of the most ancient, most rare and most ‘live’ temples in entire India.. A temple where people experience fulfillment of wishes and desires.
It is public knowledge that temples of Shri Mangal Dev are very rare. Who constructed the Mangal Dev Grah (planet) temple in Amalner and when was the idol established? There is no authentic information regarding this. Some believe that the temple was renovated for the first time in 1933. After 1940 the temple once again went into oblivion and reached a stage of dilapidation. Till 1999 the surroundings of the temple were used as a dumping ground for the town’s waste. It was also a hideout for criminals and other anti-social activities. This fact seems unbelievable but is unfortunately true.
The post 1999 renovation has brought about a miraculously pleasant transformation in the temple and its surroundings. In the last 5 to 7 years the pace of development of the place and facilities has increased.
Temple area have two halls, Tulsi garden, for water harvesting built six bunds, fountain, spectacular lighting, picturesque places, Canteen, children play in the Rotary Garden, live rabbits, fish, shellfish, devotees accommodation and all kinds of services and facilities due to this temple got famous as the picnic spot and tourist attraction.
So many schools, colleges, organizations, political parties, associations, clubs, society, social, religious, cultural institutions and the various programs come there for the trip They are cooperated by management . However, it is necessary to allow management before any program And the area of the temple is a temple had won the right to give or not to give permission to any management program There are two AC rooms, one attached non-AC room, two big halls, and adequate number of washrooms in the temple premises. Accommodation is provided at affordable cost. There are good lodges in the town also.

Amalner situated on the Bori River bank is a city in Jalgaon district of Maharashtra state is a municipal corporation. Amalner is a Taluka in Jalgaon district.

HOW TO REACH :
By Bus : 
Distance in Km to reach at Temple
  Jalgaon To Mangal Graha Temple,Amalner : 55Km To 60 Km
  Dhule To Amalner: 36Km
  Pune TO Amalner : 100 Km
By Train : 
There are many trains from Jalgaon and Dhule To Mangal Graha Temple,Amalner 
 From Mumbai : Bandra Terminus Bhusaval Express is the convenient train which stops at Amalner.  
Nearest Airport : 155 KM at Aurangabad.

description:
FULL REVIEW: https://tinyurl.com/sonylinkbuds

For the most part, I tend to be somewhat underwhelmed by Sony products - not this time! XM3 sounded OK but fit horribly, and XM4 were OK but again awkward fitting and overpriced.

The LinkBuds are also expensive for what they are, but they are the first Sony release that genuinely offer true innovation, filling a gap in the market for those who don't fancy the invasiveness of silicone tips. The call quality is outrageously good, and open design and warm sound signature make them ideal for so many use cases, and with a wide array of accessories, they aim to fit any ear without compromising stability.

The app is full of features, wide area control is ace! Battery life is disappointing though, especially when used for calls, so don't buy for long Zoom or Teams sessions, but if you're looking for good exercise buds that don't thud, don't feel invasive, and can double-up as excellent outdoor call companions, whilst still providing very good, balanced sound, the LinkBuds are your answer.

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

MUMBAI TO AMALNER : FULL TRAIN JOURNEY : 19003 BANDRA TERMINUS - BHUSAVAL KHANDESH EXPRESS 

Train 19003 KHANDESH EXP runs from Mumbai Bandra Terminus(BDTS) to Bhusaval Junction(BSL) on Tuesday, Thursday, Sunday. Train departs from Mumbai Bandra Terminus(BDTS) at 00:05 and reaches Bhusaval Junction(BSL) at 12:00. It takes 1 day to reach by train 19003 from Mumbai Bandra Terminus(BDTS) to Bhusaval Junction(BSL) .

KHANDESH Express 19003 train passes through 20 major stations. It takes total of 11:55 hours journey to reach Bhusaval Junction .

On 19003 train route maximum halt time for this train is 5 minutes at Bhestan(BHET). Train 19003 arrives at Bhestan at 04:07 and departs at 04:12. So if you want to get down from the train and buy anything from the station or for little fresh air. It's safe to get down at this station.
Other stations which have more than 5 minutes halt time is Nandurbar.

19003 Bandra Terminus Bhusaval Khandesh Express
वान्द्रे टर्मिनस - भुसावळ खानदेश एक्सप्रेस, बांद्रा टर्मिनस - भुसावल खानदेश एक्सप्रेस
Bandra Terminus Bhusaval

The 19003/19004 Khandesh Express is an express train belonging to Western Railway zone that runs between Bandra Terminus and Bhusaval Junction in India. It is currently being operated with 19003/19004 train numbers on tri-weekly basis.
The train has standard ICF rakes with max speed of 110 kmph. The 
The 19003/Bandra Terminus - Bhusaval Khandesh Express has averages speed of 47 km/hr and covers 576 km in 12h 10m.
The 19004/Bhusaval - Bandra Terminus Khandesh Express has averages speed of 50 km/hr and covers 576 km in 11h 25m.
Both trains are hauled by a Locomotive shed, Vadodara.

Bhusaval Junction

2 AC III Tier
4 Sleeper Coaches
6 General Unreserved
2 Seating cum Luggage Rake

Schedule
Train Number Station Code Departure Station Departure Time Departure Day Arrival Station Arrival Time Arrival Day

19004 BSL Bhusaval Junction 17:40 PM Sun,Tue,Thus Bandra Terminus 05:05 AM Mon,Wed,Fri

The Bhusawal Junction railway station serves Bhusawal in the Jalgaon district of the Indian state of Maharashtra. The Bhusawal railway station is one of the top-100 booking stations of Indian Railways. Approximately fourteen trains originate at Bhusawal station with 289 trains servicing the railway stop.
The Bhusawal railway station was formally established in 1863. In 1866, the Great Indian Peninsula Railway (GIPR) branch line was extended to Khandwa and then to Nagpur in 1867. Bhusawal is a divisional headquarters under Central Railways. The Bhusawal railway station was built by the then British-run Indian government at a sum of 8,00,000 Indian rupees from 1852 to 1865. The station was built with a large bath, refreshment rooms, a large workshop, dwellings for European employees, reading rooms and gymkhana. The Bhusawal railway line was opened between 1861 and 1865.
Railways in the Bhusawal area were electrified in 1968–69. Like other lines, the railway is powered by a single phase, 25 kV AC supply.
The locomotive shed at Bhusawal was established by the GIPR in 1919. At that time, it was the largest in Asia and the third-largest in the world. The Electric Locomotive Workshop at Bhusawal was established in 1974 at a cost of ₹3.52 crores and performs periodical overhauls of electric locomotives. It is also the only workshop in India to perform overhauls of three-phase, induction motor-based trains.
The Bhusawal Locomotive Shed has been accredited with the International Standard Certificate ISO 9008-2000 since April 2006.
The shed has WAM-4, WAP- 4, WAG-5, and WAG-9 locomotives.
Amenities at the Bhusawal railway station include an SBI ATM, reservation office, STD/PCO booth, waiting room, retiring room, vegetarian and non-vegetarian refreshments, information desk, post office, Wi-Fi, and more. The northern and southern entrances have separate ticketing windows. There is a free 4-wheeler parking area at the northern entrance. The Bhusawal railway station and ST stand. Elevators and electric vehicles are available for use by railway station passengers.

Mumbai Bandra Terminus also known as Vandre Terminus is a railway terminus in Bandra from where trains bound for Northern India and Western India are scheduled regularly. It was built in the 1990s to decongest the main Mumbai Central station. It is one of the five railway terminus within Greater Mumbai. The other four terminals are – Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus, Mumbai Central, Lokmanya Tilak Terminus and Dadar. It is close to Bandra Kurla Complex, a commercially important part of Mumbai as well as Mumbai Airport.

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

"6 years. 5 failed businesses. ₹2 crores earned... and lost."

They called me Elon Musk. Then, half my body got paralyzed.

I was down to my last ₹4,000-couldn't even pay my co-founder's salary. But I found a way to send him ₹36,000. He had responsibilities.

People told me to quit. My grandma questioned me. My dad called it playing business. My mom lost belief. My best friend betrayed me. I cried.

But I never stopped believing. I always had food and a home. That was enough.

Today, Refer Rush was selected as 1 of 9 startups out of 2400+ for the The TFund grant.

It took us 4 months to generate ₹1 lakh for our customers. Now, we generate ₹1.5 lakhs a day. We're profitable.

And we're just getting started.

The first five years aren't where you win they're where you get good.

Grateful for my parents. For Rohan. For this opportunity. For this life.

Never give up. Believe in yourself. Every e-commerce brand in the world will use Refer Rush.

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah:
--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

Ahmed’s & Jumanah’s cake/ كيكه احمد و جومانه 

Ingredients:

chocolate cake (any kind you like *ready or make your own *)
Cream cheese (250 g)
Sweetened condensed milk (1/2 of the can) 
1 cup of heavy cream 
Small spoon vanilla extract 
Chocolate ( your favorite ) 
Coco crispy cereal
Chocolate milk 

Note: to get the best results, make sure you put it in fridge for an hour for every layer 

المكونات:

- كيكة شوكولاتة (أي نوع تفضلونه *جاهزة أو حضروها بأنفسكم*)
- جبنة كريمية (٢٥٠ غرام)
- حليب مكثف محلى (نصف العلبة)
- كوب واحد من الكريمة الثقيلة
- ملعقة صغيرة من خلاصة الفانيليا
- شوكولاتة (النكهة المفضلة لديكم)
- رقائق كوكو المقرمشة
- حليب شوكولاتة

ملاحظة: للحصول على أفضل النتائج، ضعيها في الثلاجة لمدة ساعة لكل طبقة

The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.
